title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 122, special provisions for One Person Companies

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
content.note: Official principal Act text. Section 122(1) disapplies sections 98 and 100–111 to an OPC; subsections (2)–(3) provide a separate route for ordinary business at an OPC's annual general meeting. Check current rules and amendments before application.
